description.value: Blaze Café is a Vancouver coffee shop built around ethically sourced Indonesian beans — a Sumatra-Java blend that produces an earthy, chocolate-and-hazelnut cup. The Mount Pleasant flagship is co-located with Blaze Gourmet Burgers and runs a weekend brunch menu with hearty egg and meat dishes; a second express kiosk operates inside City Square Mall. The business also offers a mobile coffee catering service for events around the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms an active two-location Vancouver café (Mount Pleasant flagship at 43 E 5th Ave and a City Square Mall kiosk); OSM check_date of 2026-05-10 and looks_closed=false corroborate. Phone on OSM (+1-778-751-2729) differs from the website contact page ((604) 568-5486), so the website value is used and a concern flagged. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the website, so those fields remain null; vegan/GF menu items and a prominent pick-up order flow confirm Takeout and Vegetarian/vegan/GF.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-778-751-2729 but website contact page lists (604) 568-5486; website value used.
OSM record carries no address; website contact page address (43 E 5th Ave) adopted for the Mount Pleasant flagship.

OSM coordinates (49.2608, -123.1169) do not precisely match either listed address — 43 E 5th Ave is approximately -123.098 and City Square Mall is approximately -123.122; node placement may be inaccurate.
Business has two distinct physical locations (Mount Pleasant and City Square Mall); this single OSM node likely represents only one of them.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café with a live website, recent OSM verification (2026-05-10), and two confirmed Vancouver locations; a useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists.
